text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the February Stakes, Transcend was 
looking into the secrets of her rival, 
Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"On windy days at Funabashi Racecourse, 
the white dust swirls. Even now, that 
fierce white dust stays with me." Furioso 
explains that this is the very source of 
her strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since it wasn't clicking, Transcend fired 
herself up to figure it out in the race. 
And so, the second round of the Big Three 
showdown was about to begin.
